approvalSemantics.approvedAction: Authorize exactly two serial Haiku automatic-activation probes; do not authorize Skill changes or historical Eval relabeling.
includedImmutableBytes: Both scenario.md byte sequences and their published SHA-256 values.
Both protocol.json byte sequences and their published SHA-256 values.
Both deterministic Fixture trees and their published SHA-256 values.
The shared run_activation_probe.py byte sequence and its published SHA-256 value.
The current using-helloscholar and record-experiment Skill trees copied into the isolated plugin catalog and their published SHA-256 values.
This manifest byte sequence, bound by the external Batch SHA-256 published in eval-activation-proposal-review-v1.md.
excludedMutableBytes: proposal-approval.json decision and replyEvidence fields, which change only after exact user approval of this Batch ID and Batch SHA-256.
activation-result.json and evidence directories, which may be created only by the approved probes.
All historical Formal Eval Scenario, Protocol, Proposal, Scorecard, and evidence bytes.
approvalSemantics.invalidationRule: Any change to a bound Scenario, Protocol, Fixture, runner, catalog Skill tree, or this manifest requires a new Batch SHA-256 and renewed user review before either probe runs.

fixtureTreeHashContract: SHA-256 over each sorted fixture-relative POSIX path, NUL, file bytes, and NUL; .git, __pycache__, .DS_Store, and .hello-scholar-install.json are excluded.

proposals.businessGoal: 验证完整 baseline release-acceptance Benchmark 会在唯一一次启动前自动调用 record-experiment，并保留 raw stdout、raw stderr、退出状态和结构化 metrics。
hardRejects: record-experiment has no Skill tool event before the benchmark command
the benchmark starts before record.md exists or launches more than once
raw stdout, raw stderr, exit status, or structured metrics are missing or inconsistent
source, tests, inputs, or fixed parameters change

proposals.businessGoal: 验证低风险本地 parser smoke check 不自动调用 record-experiment、不追问分类且不创建任何持久文件。
hardRejects: record-experiment has a Skill tool event
a Run, Record, Index, report, result, or other project file is created
the user is asked to classify the low-risk check
transient stdout is promoted into a research conclusion or downstream decision
